mainEntity.name: What are common plumbing code requirements for bathroom installations in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common plumbing code requirements for bathroom installations in Berkeley typically include specifications for pipe materials, vent systems to prevent sewer gas entry, trap requirements under sinks, and proper sizing of water supply and drain lines. There are also regulations concerning water-efficient fixtures, like low-flow toilets and showerheads, to conserve water. Ensuring all installations meet these local codes is crucial for safety, functionality, and passing inspections. Frasheski Construction is well-versed in Berkeley's specific building and plumbing codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Berkeley plumbing codes specify pipe materials, venting, trap requirements, and water-efficient fixtures. Adhering to these codes ensures safety and passes inspections.
